title: French Salmon Tart
description: A gluten-free salmon tart with a flaky crust and a delicious salmon filling. Perfect for a special occasion dinner.
instructions: Roll out the gluten-free tart crust and place it in a tart pan.
In a separate pan, cook the salmon fillets over medium heat until they're cooked through.
In a bowl, mix together the quenched cheese, eggs, and milk. Season with salt and black pepper.
Arrange the cooked salmon fillets in the tart crust.
Pour the cheese mixture over the salmon.
Bake the tart in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is set.
Remove the tart from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve warm, garnished with caramelized tatin apples.
